program.name: Hips Open
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Long stretches for tight hips: pigeon, lizard, frog, figure four and deep squats.
program.about: Long stretches for hips that sit all day: pigeon, lizard, frog, figure four and a deep squat hold. One day works the outer hips and glutes, the next the inner thighs and hip flexors. A twist or two for the spine closes each session. Levels II and III lengthen every hold. Good on its own, or as a second session after leg training.
